bar.name: Warm Hands
bar.text: Your first skill with a cooldown each battle has +15% Double or Nothing chance.

bar.name: On a Roll
bar.text: After a Jackpot, gain Haste for 1 turn.

bar.name: Blood Debt
bar.text: After a Bust costs you HP, your next skill deals +15% damage.

bar.name: Momentum
bar.text: Each Double or Nothing trigger gives your skills +5% damage until your next Bust.

bar.name: Death Shrug
bar.text: When Lucky Escape saves you, heal 10% of your max HP.

0.f1.name: Hot Hand
0.f1.text: After a Jackpot, Double or Nothing +2% chance per rank on your next skill.

0.f2.name: Cornered Dog
0.f2.text: While below 50% HP, Double or Nothing +2% chance per rank.

0.f3.name: Quick Shuffle
0.f3.text: When Double or Nothing triggers, your next turn comes 3% sooner per rank.

0.n0.name: Chain Reaction
0.n0.text: When Double or Nothing triggers, your other cooldowns drop by 1 too.

0.r.name: Scar Gambler
0.r.text: Each Bust that costs HP gives Double or Nothing +3% chance per rank until your next Jackpot.

0.ea.name: Streak
0.ea.text: Each Double or Nothing trigger in a row adds +10% to the next roll; a failed roll resets it.

0.eb.name: Charmed Life
0.eb.text: When Lucky Escape saves you, gain Haste for 2 turns.

0.ma.name: Unbroken Run
0.ma.text: After 3 Double or Nothing triggers in a row, your next skill is a sure critical hit.

0.fa.name: All or Nothing
0.fa.text: Double or Nothing chance 25% → 40%, but when it fails, that cooldown is 1 turn longer.

0.fb.name: Coin Toss Life
0.fb.text: Lucky Escape chance 30% → 50%, but you start every battle at 80% HP.

0.mb.name: Borrowed Time
0.mb.text: After Lucky Escape saves you, Double or Nothing triggers on every skill for 2 turns.

0.v.name: Run It Back
0.v.text: When Double or Nothing triggers, the skill also fires again at once at 60% power.

1.f1.name: Steady Wrist
1.f1.text: Each repeat throw of Loaded Dice deals +6% damage per rank.

1.f2.name: Red Pips
1.f2.text: Loaded Dice Double Hit chance +1% per rank for every 20% of HP you are missing.

1.f3.name: Rolling Dice
1.f3.text: Each Loaded Dice Double Hit adds +1% power per rank to Loaded Dice until one fails to Double Hit.

1.n0.name: Endless Rattle
1.n0.text: Loaded Dice's Double Hit can repeat again and again, each time with the same chance.

1.r.name: Nimble Fingers
1.r.text: Each Loaded Dice Double Hit makes your next turn come 2% sooner per rank.

1.ea.name: Hot Dice
1.ea.text: Loaded Dice Double Hit chance 25% → 35%; each repeat throw deals +10% more than the last.

1.eb.name: Loaded Corner
1.eb.text: Loaded Dice's Double Hit is always a critical hit.

1.ma.name: Boxcars
1.ma.text: If Loaded Dice throws 3 or more times, it also hits a random other enemy once.

1.fa.name: Fever Dice
1.fa.text: Loaded Dice Double Hit chance +20%, but each throw deals 15% less damage.

1.fb.name: Spendthrift
1.fb.text: Loaded Dice costs 6 MP and deals +80% power, but Rest restores half as much MP.

1.mb.name: Snake Eyes
1.mb.text: When Loaded Dice lands a critical hit, your next wager gets +10% Jackpot chance.

1.v.name: Dice Storm
1.v.text: Loaded Dice throws 3 dice at random enemies; each die rolls its own Double Hit.

2.f1.name: Steady Stake
2.f1.text: High Stakes Bust multiplier +0.05x per rank (0.6x → 0.75x).

2.f2.name: Cautious Wager
2.f2.text: High Stakes HP stake -1% of max HP per rank (15% → 10%).

2.f3.name: Read the Room
2.f3.text: High Stakes +2% Jackpot chance per rank against a target below 50% HP.

2.n0.name: Due for a Win
2.n0.text: Each High Stakes Bust gives the next High Stakes +15% Jackpot chance, stacking until a Jackpot.

2.r.name: Twist the Knife
2.r.text: A High Stakes Jackpot has a 15% chance per rank to extend one target status by 1 turn.

2.ea.name: Knockout Bet
2.ea.text: A High Stakes Jackpot Slows the target for 2 turns.

2.eb.name: Hedged Bet
2.eb.text: When High Stakes Busts, you are Fortified for 1 turn.

2.ma.name: Haymaker
2.ma.text: A High Stakes Jackpot against a Slowed target Stuns it for 1 turn.

2.fa.name: Dirty Fighting
2.fa.text: A High Stakes Jackpot always Stuns, but High Stakes pays 2x → 1.5x.

2.fb.name: Penny Ante
2.fb.text: High Stakes stakes only 5% of max HP, but its Jackpot pays 2x → 1.6x.

2.mb.name: Sure Thing
2.mb.text: While High Stakes has 70% or more Jackpot chance, it stakes no HP.

2.v.name: Called Game
2.v.text: High Stakes bets the target's fate: Jackpot Stuns it 1 turn, Bust Jinxes it; HP stake 15% → 8%.

3.f1.name: Sharp Corners
3.f1.text: Card Trick +5% power per rank against Stunned targets.

3.f2.name: Jack of Clubs
3.f2.text: Card Trick +4% power per rank against targets with a status.

3.f3.name: Swift Suit
3.f3.text: Card Trick Slow odds +5% per rank.

3.n0.name: Trump Card
3.n0.text: Card Trick always deals Stun to a Jinxed target.

3.r.name: Long Con
3.r.text: Card Trick's Stun has a 5% chance per rank to last 1 turn longer.

3.ea.name: Stacked Deck
3.ea.text: Before Card Trick, choose its status: Slow, Wound or Stun (Stun lands on the first target only).

3.eb.name: Distracting Fan
3.eb.text: Enemies hit by Card Trick deal 15% less damage on their next attack.

3.ma.name: Double Deal
3.ma.text: Each Card Trick card deals two different statuses: your Stacked Deck pick and a random one.

3.fa.name: Cold Deck
3.fa.text: Card Trick always deals Stun, but its cooldown is 3 → 5.

3.fb.name: Smoke Cards
3.fb.text: Card Trick Blinds both targets for 2 turns, but deals no damage.

3.mb.name: Blinding Flurry
3.mb.text: Card Trick Blinds every enemy it hits for 1 turn, on top of its status.

3.v.name: Returning Cards
3.v.text: Every Card Trick card flies back for a second hit at 60% power, rolling a new status.

4.u1.name: Fat Stack
4.u1.text: All In Jackpot pays +0.02x more per MP staked (0.0667x → 0.0867x).

4.u2.name: Mortgage
4.u2.text: All In also stakes 10% of max HP, counted as extra MP for its payout.

4.u3.name: High Roller
4.u3.text: An All In that stakes 25+ MP ignores 50% of Armor and cannot miss.

4.r1.name: Run the Table
4.r1.text: If All In kills, its cooldown ends.

4.r2.name: Clean Sweep
4.r2.text: If All In kills, you get back the MP you staked.

4.r3.name: Domino
4.r3.text: If All In kills, it strikes a random enemy for 60% of its damage.

4.d1.name: Ride the Wave
4.d1.text: All In +10% Double or Nothing chance.

4.d3.name: Blitz
4.d3.text: All In is ready from the start of each battle, with no opening cooldown.

4.l1.name: Grudge Ledger
4.l1.text: All In +2% damage for each hit you took since its last use.

4.l2.name: Heartbeat
4.l2.text: All In deals +1% damage for every 1% of HP you are missing.

4.l3.name: Last Breath
4.l3.text: While you are below 25% HP, All In is always a Jackpot.
